batch_definition: M6-M8: each counted batch has positive delivery and depot-return quantities
runtime_path_basis: Project-root-relative paths; no runtime dependencies outside this dataset
limitations: Appointments are synthetic and conditioned on an explicit feasible physical schedule, not independent empirical observations. Vehicle and route assignments in the witness are not binding input decisions and are not supplied as solver starts.
Feasibility witnesses are not optimization results or algorithm success claims.
Zero waiting cost remains unchanged; interleaved windows do not eliminate all waiting.

demand_contract.goods_weight: Preserve the complete original customer goods weight.
demand_contract.assumption: Each customer demand fits one standard box; no bin-packing optimization.
